document_name: City of Medicine Hat - LMS tender.pdf

extracted_fields.contract_term: Five (5) years, with an option to extend annually for an additional two (2) years.
extracted_fields.scope_of_deliverables: Provision, implementation, configuration, training, and support for a modern Corporate Learning Management System (LMS).
extracted_fields.mandatory_submission_requirements: Submission Form (Appendix B) completed and signed, Pricing (Appendix C / Proposal Form).
extracted_fields.mandatory_technical_requirements: Must meet Functional Requirements, Scope of Work, and technical/security criteria outlined in Appendix E and Appendix D.
extracted_fields.evaluation_criteria: Stage 1: Technical Capability (50 pts), Vendor Experience & References (15 pts), Implementation & Support (20 pts), Pricing (15 pts). Stage 2 (Demo): Product Demonstration (30 pts). Total: 130 points.
extracted_fields.minimum_score_threshold: Minimum technical score of 35 out of 50 points in Stage 1 to advance.
extracted_fields.pricing_requirements: CAD, exclusive of GST, itemized by one-time implementation costs and annual recurring subscription/licensing costs.
extracted_fields.minimum_insurance_requirements: Commercial General Liability: $2,000,000 per occurrence; Professional Errors and Omissions: $1,000,000 per claim ($2,000,000 aggregate); Cyber Liability: $2,000,000 per occurrence; Automobile Liability: $2,000,000 inclusive.
extracted_fields.vendor_experience_qualifications: Experience providing LMS services over the last 5 years, including municipal/government implementations.
extracted_fields.number_of_references_required: Minimum of three (3) client references similar in scope & size over the last 5 years.
extracted_fields.data_security_privacy_requirements: Compliance with PIPA, SOC2/ISO, Azure AD SSO, MFA, encryption at rest and in transit, and Cybersecurity Vendor Assessment (CVA).
extracted_fields.data_hosting_residency_requirements: Vendor server preferred within Canada or option for cloud storage in Canada.
extracted_fields.vendor_demonstration_requirement: Yes, Stage 2 Product Demonstration for top-ranked proponents meeting technical threshold (scored out of 30 points).
